events.title: 풀럼 break the Division Two transfer record once again when they pay 블랙번 로버스 £2million for defender Chris Coleman .
애스턴 빌라 overcome FC Steaua București in the UEFA Cup third round with goals from Savo Milošević and Ian Taylor .
리버풀 sign USA goalkeeper 브래드 프리델 from Columbus Crew for £1million.
맨체스터 유나이티드 agree to sell Czech winger Karel Poborský to 벤피카 after an unsuccessful 18 months at Old Trafford .

The English FA continue investigations into an Asian Betting Syndicate's links with English hooligans and mobsters to continuously shut off floodlights in Premiership stadia to get matches with "unfavourable" results postponed and cancelled. Affected clubs like 웨스트햄 유나이티드 , 더비 카운티 , 아스널 and 볼턴 원더러스 all filed official inquiries.

1997 draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now leading by a five-point margin over their nearest contenders 블랙번 로버스. 첼시, 리버풀 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five, but 아스널 are now sixth and now need something little short of a miracle to bring the Premier League trophy to Highbury . Meanwhile, 반즐리 prop up the top flight, while 에버턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the bottom three. 미들즈브러 and 노팅엄 포리스트 are level on points at the top of Division One, with the playoff zone being occupied by 셰필드 유나이티드, 찰턴 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 .
